# A tab opened while liberttyd is being replaced (in liberttyd: --persist):
# nothing listens on its socket for a moment, its lock is held (see
# liberttyd-replacing.sh). The window isn't held up for it, and the tab's
# session is made in the new liberttyd once it answers, not in a shell of
# the window's own (which has no $LIBERTTY_SESSION).
wait:1
shell:sh @ROOT@/tests/fixtures/liberttyd-replacing.sh
tab:new
wait:4
type:test -n "$LIBERTTY_SESSION" && echo made-in-$((6*7))
key:enter
wait:1
expect:made-in-42
